verdict.rationale: Gumloop's 'Hosted MCPs' enterprise feature lets an organization build and deploy custom MCP servers on Gumloop's infrastructure (with GitHub-based deploy pipeline), which matches the ask of exposing capabilities as MCP tools callable by external agents; but most MCP evidence in the pack is about Gumloop acting as an MCP *client* (connecting to external servers), and the server-hosting capability requires writing separate server code rather than a one-click 'expose this workflow as a tool' flow, and is gated to enterprise tier. Missing for 10: evidence that existing workflows/connectors can be auto-exposed as MCP tools without custom code, independent/hands-on confirmation of Hosted MCPs working, and details on tool-call authentication/discovery for external agents.
